newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil abductors easily buy secret phone lists - TV.
newsitem.headline: Brazil abductors easily buy secret phone lists - TV.

text.p: Kidnapping rings in Brazil have easy access to confidential phone lists with the home addresses and unlisted numbers of leading politicians, soccer players and businessmen, Globo television said Thursday.

An armed gang in Rio de Janeiro provided Globo with a list containing the names of hundreds of the city's wealthiest residents, including celebrities, all of whom had requested private listings for security reasons.
The details were supposed to have been held confidentially by the local telephone company, accessible only to certain employees entrusted with a secret computer password, Globo said.
In a series of investigative reports this week, Globo showed how criminals can illegally buy guns, explosives and bugging devices through a network of small firms working under a variety of covers.
On Monday, Globo revealed that corrupt Brazilian policemen have set up a sophisticated network to sell government arms and ammunition to clients including drug traffickers.
